_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. A leaf with "var" takes its value from that variable in css-vars.json, resolved inside its "owner" (framer = the marketing pages' body tokens; anam = the Next.js apps' :root set on /pricing, /get-demo, /tools; mintlify = the docs' :root theme vars). A leaf with "value" carries a measured value and names the measurement in "source" (raw/measurements.md / components-computed.json). anam.ai is three surfaces: the Framer marketing pages (white ground, black ink, one orange accent, glass pills on the avatar videos), the Next.js app pages (a small semantic :root set), and the Mintlify docs (a warm-stone ramp; the only surface with a dark theme).

500.description: Anam orange #ff6200. The one accent every surface shares: hero badge, nav-underline on docs, active sidebar tint, link underline, primary icon colour. The Framer body declares it as --token-ae7f21ed-…; the docs as --primary 255 98 0.

tint.description: The hero badge's wash: brand orange at 5% over white

tint-strong.description: The active-item tint on docs: brand orange at ~10%

brand.$description: One orange carries the whole brand. It is never a ramp: hover goes one step lighter, active fills sit at 5–10% alpha.
